title: Probability depends only on the initial segment
statement: For any real bias parameter $\rho$, nonnegative integers $n,t$, and predicate $P$ on Boolean strings, the biased probability that the first $n$ entries of a string of length $n+t$ satisfy $P$ equals the biased probability of $P$ on strings of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on Boolean strings
